title: carex remota var. subloliacea

This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine to provide several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic effects.
